title: Production Acceptance Gate & Release Certification
decision: YELLOW — production-ready CONDITIONAL on deployment prerequisites (application code fully verified; browser UX, live Groq, and reverse-proxy topology UNVERIFIED in this environment)
decision_phrase: STAGE 27 decision: YELLOW — the application is production-ready: 447/447 tests pass, the complete user lifecycle, cross-user isolation, XP economy (ledger SUM == total_xp, no negative/duplicate/client-controlled rewards), data integrity (likes_count, orphans, level formula), the AI trust boundary (deterministic engines + graceful 503 fallback), security (no auth bypass, no IDOR, no SQLi/XSS, no secret leakage, timing-enumeration oracle closed), observability (X-Request-Id + structured events), DB failure/recovery (readiness 503→200, pool auto-reconnect, no crash), concurrency (exactly-one mutation, no duplicate XP), performance (auth never starves unrelated users), and backup/restore (23 tables + XP ledger round-trip) are all verified by executed evidence. GREEN is withheld because three deployment-dependent surfaces remain UNVERIFIED in this environment: real-browser UX (no Chromium), live Groq AI provider (no GROQ_API_KEY), and the reverse-proxy trust topology (trust proxy=1 vs production proxy), plus documented infrastructure-owned prerequisites (backup/PITR/RPO/RTO, object-storage sidecar, TLS/security headers at the proxy).

environment.note: Environment was reset; Stage 26.1 commit 293cd6f was lost and the working tree was reconstructed as 99f13e3 and re-verified from scratch.

findings.description: trust proxy=1 trusts one X-Forwarded-For hop; when the API is directly reachable, XFF can be spoofed to defeat the IP-keyed auth rate limiter.
findings.evidence: Stage 26.1: 25/25 signins with unique XFF returned 401 (zero 429s).
findings.resolution: Deploy behind a reverse proxy that overwrites X-Forwarded-For, or disable trust proxy when directly exposed.

findings.description: Real-browser acceptance (mobile/desktop, full lifecycle, refresh/back/forward/double-click/offline) not executed — no Chromium in sandbox.
findings.evidence: no puppeteer cache / system chromium / puppeteer dep.
findings.resolution: Run Part 13 on a staging deploy with real Chromium.

findings.description: Live Groq AI provider generation not executed — GROQ_API_KEY unset.
findings.evidence: chat returns 503 'AI coach is not configured'.
findings.resolution: Provision GROQ_API_KEY and validate live generation.

findings.description: pg_dump/psql not bundled in runtime; logical backup uses COPY protocol. PITR/RPO/RTO are infrastructure-owned.
findings.evidence: runtime bin contains only initdb/pg_ctl/postgres; backup/restore verified via pg-copy-streams.
findings.resolution: Managed backup + PITR at infrastructure layer.

findings.description: No SIGTERM/SIGINT drain handler (clean exit but no in-flight request drain).
findings.resolution: Add drain handler if a draining LB is used.

findings.description: No security-header middleware (helmet/HSTS/CSP); relies on reverse proxy for transport/TLS headers.
findings.evidence: no security headers on responses; documented Stage 23.
findings.resolution: Set headers at the proxy (or add header middleware).

findings.description: Quest templates have no committed seed script; must be provisioned out-of-band.
No automated backup/PITR in the repository.
findings.evidence: docs + repo scan; restore demonstrated manually.

findings.description: Object storage depends on the Replit sidecar (127.0.0.1:1106); unverified in sandbox.

prerequisites: reverse proxy with X-Forwarded-For overwrite (or trust proxy off)
provision GROQ_API_KEY and validate live AI
